ov: Three species of huge rays of warm seas, with triangular fins and horn-shaped flaps by the mouth. They filter-feed on plankton and have one of the highest brain-to-body ratios of any fish.

why.et: Caught for meat and products; the flesh is edible but thought less tasty than other fish.

rg: Warm temperate, subtropical and tropical oceans.

cf.tip: Mantas belong to the same order as stingrays; they filter-feed on plankton.

fx: Like whales, mantas leap out of the water, and nobody knows why.
notes: Group entry (two of the three species are Vulnerable).
